notes.title: Zoombinis changelog notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have received requests to list what's different in the patch update that was recently released. 

The following changes were made:

*More detailed help in each puzzle

*Optional on-screen captions in English and Spanish

*Bug fixes for Mirror Machine on the Very Very Hard Level

*Other bug fixes in Fleens and during puzzle transitions. 

*Fixes for game saving issues under certain conditions in the Windows version.

If you see anything that still may need to be addressed, please let us know on the forums and we're happy to look into it. 

Thank you!

Jason Carver
Encore Software Product Manager / Customer Service

notes.title: Zoombinis update is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a long time but we're happy to let you know that not too long ago, an update was released to the game which fixes a big issue with saving games and also some other updates to make the game function better. 

As always we really appreciate your support on Zoombinis. If you have any feedback or are still running into issues please use the bug thread to address these and we will pass them onto the developer. 

-Jason C
Product Manager / Customer Service at Encore Software

notes.title: Zoombinis has been updated!
notes.content:
Players should now see an updated build of the game automatically download to their Steam Client.

Fixes for the following issues includes:

-The Fleens puzzle does not let you continue if you win as you lose a Zoombini

- Lose a Zoombini if odd total enter in Mirror Cave

- Hit box to grab Zoombinis is off

- Users can get infinite pad changes

-Once Fleens are chased away game does not progress

-Other fixes, etc.
